environment: macOS Editor / Mono / Metal; not a WebGL build
measurementCaveats: Editor, tool, and test-driver allocations are included in the global GC counter and collection counts.
GC.GetAllocatedBytesForCurrentThread is a stub in this Editor; native GC.Alloc size metadata was used and validated with a 4KB allocation probe.
Before-run event durations are Stopwatch measurements; native event allocation metadata is available in the post capture and isolated overlap comparison.
Texture counters include Editor views, UI, and retained assets. They are not browser heap/VRAM measurements.
No claim of a meaningful frame-rate improvement is made from a single before/after Editor capture.
